# UncheckMenu <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Menus](BlitzPlus-Menus)

</div>


```blitzbasic
UncheckMenu:Void menu:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `menu` | In | Int32 | required | Handle of a menu item. |

## Description

Removes the check mark that [CheckMenu](CheckMenu) put in front of an item.
